text: Formula for calculating the Cumulative Performance Index (CPI), clause 12(1). CPI = (sum of Cn x Mn) divided by (sum of Cn), where the sums are taken only over the courses that the student has passed with not less than 50% marks and for which credits are earned. Cn is the number of credits earned for course n in any semester. Mn is the marks obtained by the student in course n. N is the total number of courses over which the performance is being measured, and n runs from 1 to N. All courses have maximum marks of 100 irrespective of the number of credits assigned to the course. Courses in which the student appeared but secured less than 50% marks are not counted; they are treated as Audit Courses and shown that way in the final mark sheet.
